//: Ceilings for the single-file shells. Raise one IN THE COMMIT that needs the bytes, and say what bought them. Checked by scripts/test-spaces-size.mjs.

spaces.//: 216 KiB. Everything from the roadmap's M3/M4 content work plus the formatting UI: tables, media, link cards, comments, export-page-as-space and subtree import, then a properties panel and a selection toolbar with a real mark engine. 166,482 B before the batch and 213,370 B after — +46,888 B, and by far the largest step this shell has taken. Seven branches each measured a raise against the same stale baseline and landed on four different numbers; this one is measured on the stack itself, which is the only place the real figure exists. Zopfli is already applied and is what keeps this near 200 rather than past 220. Headroom is deliberate: the shell is mostly one compressed block and the packer's output differs across node versions (one commit measured 130,095 B on node 26 locally and 131,246 B on CI node 24), so a tight ceiling fails in CI for no reason. CI is the number that counts.
